translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaa Tokkanaw Imetteedda Imotaa
Med'inaa Goday Musew hawaadan yaageedda;
«Taw immiyaawaa ahanaadan neeni Israa'eelatoo oda; taw immanaw Aa wozanay Aa imma imma giyaa asaa ubbaa imotaa neeni taw akka.
Hinttenttu unttunttuppe akkana imotay hawaa: work'k'aa, biraa, nahaasiyaa birataa,
saluwaa malatiyaa, ochchaa teeraa malatiyaanne, zo'o liik'o k'ac'inaa, deeshshaa isikiyaa,
dorssaa orggiyaa galbbaa zo'o k'alamiyaan yeggi kesseeddawaa, hara galbbaa, odooruwaa,
s'omppiyaw wogaraa zayitiyaa, okkiyaa zayitiyaanne is'aanaa sawetsiyaa k'imaamiyaa;
K'eesatuwaa kaappuwaa eefuudiyaaninne tiraan wotsiyaawaan yeggiyaa margidiyaa geetettiyaa shuchchatuwaanne hara p'ooliyaa al"o shuchchatuwaa aho.
«Yaatiide taani unttunttu giddon ak'anaadan, unttunttu taw Geeshsha sa'aa giigissino.
Likke taani neena besseedda leemisuwaa ubbaadan S'oossaa Dunkkaaniyaanne Aa giddon de'iyaa miishshatuwaa ootsite.
K'aalaa c'aak'uwaa Taabootaa
«Unttunttu odooruwaa mitsaappe adussatetsay laa"u wad'anne bagga, gomppay itti wad'anne bagga, geesay k'ay itti wad'anne bagga gideedda Taabootaa med'd'ino.
Soyaanne kariyaa walakay baynna work'k'aan sheeshsha; Aa yuushshuwaakka work'k'aa tigetsan yuushsha aatsa.
He Taabootaw oyddu work'k'aa sagaayetuwaa tigaade oyddu gedetuwaan itti baggana laa"u sagaayetuwaa, k'ay yenkko baggana laa"u sagaayetuwaa aatsa.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan odooruwaappe kasuwaa kessaade work'k'aan sheeshsha.
Taabootaa tookkanaw, Taabootaa miyyiyaan de'iyaa sagaayetuwaan kasuwaa aatsa.
Tookkiyaa kasotuu Taabootaa sagaayetuwaa giddon de'ino; unttunttu hewaappe ubbakka kesoppino.
Taabootaa giddon taani new immiyaa, tammu azazatuu s'aafetti utteedda laa"u masetteedda markkatetsaa shuchchatuwaa wotsa.
«Walakay baynna work'k'aappe laa"u wad'anne bagga aduk'k'iyaa, itti wad'anne bagga aakkiyaa atto giyaa sa'aa k'um"iyaa med'd'a.
K'um"iyaw wurssetsaa laa"u bagga gas'an laa"u kiruubeeliyaa, k'os'etteedda work'k'aappe med'd'a.
Itti kiruubiyaa itti bagga gas'an, laa"entso kiruubiyaa yenkko bagga gas'an laa"uwaakka k'um"iyaanna gatsa oytsaade med'd'a.
Kiruubetuu barenttu k'efiyaa dentsiide, atto giyaa sa'aa k'um"iyaa barenttu k'efiyaan kuway wotsino; k'ay ittuu ittuwaakko simmi uttiide, k'um"iyaa s'eellino.
K'um"iyaa Taabootaw bolla baggan wotsa; k'ay taani new immiyaa azazatuu s'aafettiidde masetteedda shuchchatuwaa Taabootaa giddon wotsa.
Markkatetsaa Taabootaa bolla k'um"iyaa bolla de'iyaa laa"u kiruubetuwaappe gidduwaan taani neenana gakettaade Israa'eeliyaa asaw taani immiyaa azazuwaa ubbaa yaan new immana.
Ukitsaa Wotsiyaa S'arip'p'eezaa
«Odooruwaa mitsaappe adussatetsaa laa"u wad'aa, gomppay itti wad'aa, geesay k'ay itti wad'anne bagga gidiyaa itti s'arp'p'eezaa med'd'a.
Yaataade walakay baynna work'k'aan sheeshsha; k'ay Aa yuushshuwaan work'k'aa tigetsaa yuushsha aatsa.
Hewaadankka, k'ay gomppay takkaad'e gideedda shaashiyaa Aa bolla yuushsha aatsa. Yaataade Aa bolla work'k'aa tigetsaa yuushsha.
He s'arip'p'eezaw oyddu work'k'aa sagaayetuwaa med'd'aade, s'arip'p'eezaa gedetuu de'iyaa oyddu gas'an wotsa.
S'arip'p'eezaa tookkanaw kasuwaa aatsiyaa sagaayetuu s'arip'p'eezaw shaashiyaa gas'aan shiik'iide de'ino.
He tookkiyaa kasuwaa odooruwaappe kessaade, work'k'aan unttuntta sheeshsha.
Hewaadankka, k'ay shaatatuwaanne c'ilppatuwaa, duuk'k'iyaabatuwaanne s'uu'atuwaa walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'a.
Ta sintsa aatsiyaa geeshsha ukitsay ubbaa wodekka s'arip'p'eezaa bolla d'ayoppo.
S'omppiyaa Wotsiyaa Ballaa

«S'omppiyaa wotsiyaa baalaa k'os'etteedda walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'a; he baallay ek'k'iyaa gediikka, k'ay giddo toomaykka ubbay k'os'etteedda work'k'aappe oosettanaw koshshee. Aa wanc'c'atuu, Aa kukkumotuu Aa c'iishshatuu ubbay aanana ittippe oyk'etti med'ettanaw koshshee.
Miyyiyaanna usuppun maratuu aw kesiino; maratuwaappe heezzatuu itti baggana, k'ay heezzatuu yenkko baggana de'ino.
Usuppun maratookka huup'iyaan huup'iyaan heezu heezu kukkumuunne c'iishshay de'iyaa lawuziyaa c'iishshaa malatiyaa wanc'c'ay de'o.
S'omppiyaa wotsiyaa baallaw giddo toomay, kukkumotuwaa c'iishshatuu de'iyaa lawuziyaa c'iishshaa malatiyaa oyddu wanc'c'ay de'o.
Laa"uu laa"uu ittippe waatsan de'iyaa heezzu maratuwaappe garssana itti itti kukkumuu de'o.
Kukkumatuunne maratuu ubbay s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa baalaana ittippe, oyk'k'etti ittuwaa gidiide, walakay baynna work'k'aappe k'os'ettiide med'ettino.
«Hewaappe guyyiyaan s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa baallaw laappun s'omppetuwaa giigissaade, unttunttu sintsa giddow poo'ana mala d'ok'k'u ootsaadde wotsa.
S'omppiyaa toyssiyaa k'ap'etuwaanne unttuntta wotsiyaawantta walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'a.
S'omppiyaa wotsiyaa baallaynne an go"ettiyaa miishshaa ubbay hattamanne ichcheshu kiilo giraame gideedda walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'ettiino.
Akeeka; taani neena deriyaa huup'iyaan besseeddawaadan kiiteta.
